claim.quote: The response of the detector is then interpreted, using the F nuclei content of the gas, in terms of sensitivity to proton spin-dependent WIMP-nucleon interactions, displaying a minimum in sensitivity cross section at 0.5 pb for a WIMP mass of 100 GeV/c^2.

name: Spin-Dependent Limits from the DRIFT-IId Directional Dark Matter Detector

summary.plain: DRIFT-IId's first competitive result: a limit on dark matter interacting through spin, obtained while rejecting a radon-related background.
summary.technical: 47.4 live days with a 0.8 m^3 fiducial volume (30 Torr CS2 + 10 Torr CF4) and passive shielding; radon-progeny recoils from the central cathode rejected by their large diffusion; spin-dependent WIMP-proton sensitivity minimum 0.5 pb at 100 GeV/c^2.

title: Spin-Dependent Limits from the DRIFT-IId Directional Dark Matter Detector
why_it_matters: First spin-dependent limit from the DRIFT-IId directional detector.
